simple.summary: אֲרָב (ʼĂrâb) means Arab , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 52.

definitions.full: H694. Arab אֲרָב proper name, of a location city near Hebron Josh 15:52 ( ᵐ5 Ἐρεμ , ᵐ5 L Ἐρεβ ; according to Onomoasticon Ἐρεμινθα Lag On. 254, 2nd ed. 260 Ereb Id. 119, 2nd ed.152 , a village Heromith in Daroma; compare Di Survey iii. 311 ).
